name: OPTIMJACK: code injected into Optimizely Web Experimentation snippets, 16 November 2026
notes: Stages as Report URI evaluated them: load track.js from 1688360.cc, or run the inline fallback (needs 'unsafe-eval' or 'unsafe-inline'); send stolen data to 1688360.cc (connect-src); load the iOS kit (script-src, frame-src).
The loader is created by the trusted snippet with document.createElement('script'), so it is not parser-inserted and 'strict-dynamic' trusts it.
The attacker hosts are taken down; they appear here only as addresses a policy is asked about. Nothing is fetched from them.
